causal_chain: 30,000 keys of 8 KiB each are written to Redis, taking the footprint from under 2 MiB to 298 MiB
Redis stays up and answers in under a millisecond, so no job fails and no objective moves
the pressure is visible only in the dependency's own reading, which is the whole evidence
the paged job dispatch-latency objective is whole, so the page is not confirmed

why_this_file_is_separate: ADR 0038: the wall around the answer key is structural. The replay client loads the recording through `recorder.load_recording`, which takes one path and has no way to reach this file; `RecordedWorld` forbids extra keys, so a ground truth cannot ride inside a recording either. Pinned by tests/unit/test_recorder.py.
